press_references.value: Synack Unveils Active Offense Agentic AI Solution to Validate Exploitable Vulnerabilities

product_launches.description: Synack launched Active Offense, an AI-powered solution integrated into its PTaaS platform, which autonomously validates exploitable vulnerabilities to help security teams prioritize and remediate real threats.

overview_description.description: Synack delivers continuous security validation by combining agentic AI with the world’s most rigorously vetted community of security researchers, helping organizations proactively reduce risk, stay compliant, and stay ahead of evolving cyber threats. Synack’s agentic AI Sara handles reconnaissance, attack surface mapping, and initial exploit validation at scale, while the Synack Red Team applies human judgement and creativity that automation cannot replicate. Founded by former NSA operatives, Synack has enabled nearly 10 million hours of expert testing to protect critical assets, from global financial systems to U.S. Defense Department networks. Synack was recognized by GigaOm’s 2025 PTaaS Radar as both a Leader and Fast Mover, and received Global InfoSec Awards for Market Leader in AI-Powered Cybersecurity and Trailblazer in PTaaS. Learn more at www.synack.com.

about_short_description.short_description: Human + AI platform for continuous security validation and AI pentesting, powered by the Synack Red Team.

product.name: Synack Platform
product.description: A cloud-based penetration testing platform for managing continuous security validation, on-demand researchers, vulnerability workflows, integrations, reporting, and attack-surface testing.

product.name: Sara AI Pentesting
product.description: An AI-driven pentesting capability that identifies, validates, and prioritizes vulnerabilities across enterprise attack surfaces, with Synack Red Team researchers validating exploitable risk.

product.name: Penetration Testing as a Service
product.description: A continuous, on-demand penetration testing service combining AI agents and vetted security researchers to identify, validate, prioritize, and report exploitable vulnerabilities.

product.name: Synack Red Team
product.description: A vetted global community of security researchers providing human-led penetration testing, vulnerability validation, specialized research missions, and offensive security expertise.

product.name: Attack Surface Management
product.description: A continuous service that discovers, fingerprints, and prioritizes internet-facing assets, helping security teams identify blind spots and direct testing toward exposed risk.

product.name: AI and LLM Pentesting
product.description: A penetration testing service for artificial intelligence and large language model systems, identifying security weaknesses in AI applications, models, integrations, and related interfaces.
